Researchers
found
that
employee
productivity
is
related
to
their
ability
to
see
greenery
and
the
natural
environment
outside
.
Not
seeing
it
would
be
less
efficient
,
leading
to
increased
stress
and
lower
cognitive
performance
.
Another
study
found
that
artificial
green
plants
can
have
the
same
effect
even
if
there
are
no
windows
.
For
example
,
a
recent
experiment
showed
that
workers
in
windowless
offices
with
indoor
plants
completed
tasks
faster
than
